name: scope-lock
description: /scope locks Claude to the files you name; edits outside the scope are blocked.

allowTemp.title: Allow temp folders
allowTemp.description: Let writes to /tmp (and macOS temp folders) through while a scope is set, for logs and scratch files.

blockUncheckable.title: Block uncheckable shell writes
blockUncheckable.description: While a scope is set, block Bash writes whose target uses $VARIABLES, command substitution or a cd that cannot be followed.
